findings.details: Documents LPDDR5 ARC PMU firmware and source build. Source author's clean-room provenance claim is recorded but not independently certified.
DRAM_SUN60I_A733 is explicitly described as LPDDR5; A733 has no selectable LPDDR4 configuration.
sun60i_a733_dmc_clock_setup fixes the DMC mode to LPDDR5. MR8 size decoding and data-rate reporting use LPDDR5 semantics. Not a DRAM-type-neutral initializer.
Controller/PHY/PIE tables are explicitly LPDDR5. Reviewed online; not installed as this board's initialization table.
Functions named pmu_is_lpddr4/pmu_is_lpddr5 inspect different MR19/MR20 fields rather than a mutually exclusive memory-type selector. Their names do not establish a working LPDDR4 training path.

findings.section: T736 User Manual rev 0.90, 11.1, printed page 409
findings.details: DRAMC section lists features only, then proceeds to UFS. It does not provide LPDDR4 training or detailed private DDR PHY register programming documentation.

remaining: Board-specific LPDDR4 controller timings, MR programming, address map, CA/DQ wiring and voltage configuration
Source-built LPDDR4 ARC PMU training with tested cold-start behavior
SPL early storage and handoff integration plus independent hardware validation
constraint: Vendor DDR library and PMU binary were explicitly rejected by user; this is an implementation gap, not a pending approval.
subsequent_hardware_correction: On this actual LPDDR4 board MSTR=0x03081002, so the inspected A733 source bit19 LPDDR5 test is not type-discriminating. Full training remains missing.
